value.rationale: A canonical Euclidean invariant of a natural infinite two-parameter convex-polytope family. Determines a sharp q=2p packing transition, corrects a nonsharp 2q bound by exactly q-2p when q>2p, characterizes every farthest pair, and counts these pairs through nontrivial injections with overlap exclusions. Exact pairs support future benchmarking of graph matching-polytope geometry; no downstream theorem is required.
